capabilities: Chat about the opened note or a selected excerpt with fixed conversation scope
Mark materials as own notes, external sources, or AI text for attribution
Summarize old messages while keeping and exporting the full verbatim history
Generate concept maps and turn discussion into editable draft notes for review
Optionally index allowed folders for manual retrieval before results join the chat
extras: Interface and full manual are in Chinese. API keys are stored in plain text in data.json inside the vault, so syncing the plugin folder also syncs keys; documents and conversation context are sent to the user-configured endpoint. Install is manual via GitHub Release.
problem: Vault-wide AI chat tools search or embed the entire vault and blur conversation scope; some users want discussions tied to explicitly chosen documents with clear attribution.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (base URL, API key, model name)

summary: AI chat companion scoped to the opened note or a selected passage, with per-conversation history files and editable draft-note output.
